# Hershy

> A workspace for short-form video creators. Hershy watches a Short, or reads a
> hook or a script, and keeps answering follow-up questions about it in one
> conversation. The work is filed into projects, and a connected YouTube channel
> gives every answer the creator's real audience-retention curve to sit on.
> Shorts only.

Hershy is aimed at people making vertical short-form video (YouTube Shorts,
TikTok, Reels). It is not a general video editor and it does not generate video.
What separates it from a chat wrapper is that a connected YouTube channel gives
it the creator's own audience-retention data, so its feedback is tied to real
drop-off timestamps rather than to opinion.

Its video review is deliberately editor-facing: every fix has to be applicable to
footage the creator already has, inside three minutes in CapCut or Premiere.
It will say "add a cash register sound on the word money at 0:04" or "put a slow
punch-in across the opening clip". It will not tell you to re-shoot or rewrite
the script.

## Surfaces

- Analyze: one conversation, not a form. Send a pasted YouTube link, an uploaded
  video file, a written hook or a full script. For a video it watches the whole
  thing, builds a beat-by-beat read of every cut, overlay and sound, scores it
  out of 100 across hook, retention, payoff and delivery, and returns timestamped
  edit fixes. For a creator's own published video it maps the real retention
  drop-offs onto that timeline. Follow-up questions are answered against the
  analysis already in the thread, so the review is a starting point rather than a
  verdict.
- Projects: folders holding a conversation, the video it was about, and the ideas
  saved off it. A conversation filed into a project reopens where it was left.
- Analytics: the creator's own YouTube numbers, alongside the retention curves of
  the videos they have run through Hershy.
- Competitors: tracks rival channels and surfaces only the Shorts that clearly
  beat that channel's own median views per day, then rebuilds the idea for the
  user's niche instead of copying it.

## Pricing

- Free: 20 credits, no card required, one time with no monthly refill. Enough for
  a few videos or several hook and script checks. Competitors requires a paid
  plan.
- Plus: $9.99 per month, or $119.99 per year. 300 credits per month.
- Pro: $19.99 per month, or $155.99 per year (an effective $12.99 per month).
  Unlimited credits under a fair-use ceiling.
- Extra credits: $4.99 for 100.

One credit balance covers every surface, so users only spend on what they use.
A video costs 5 credits, a script check 3, a hook check 2, a follow-up message 1.
